rules.Evidence: text pattern (our channel words, invitations, literal email/phone)
text pattern without an explicit consignee/supplier role

explicit consignee/recipient or supplier role + shipping/verification purpose, or this turn's AskFields authorization for THAT field key; a role that is authorized for one field does not authorize another (name != contact channel, supplier address != supplier contact)

one structured request-item list (source span, action, verb source/inheritance, role, concrete FieldKey, purpose, collect/clarify) shared by Test-ContactRedline and Test-AskFieldConformance; a conjoined request inherits the ACTION but not the ROLE (purpose clauses, new verbs/owners, personal pronouns and sentence boundaries end the role scope)

structured ClarificationRequests derived from the ONE fact model (CargoFacts.ByKey status + Conflicts.Candidates with value/unit/scope/source refs + Destination ambiguity). Every number in a clarification clause must match a real candidate (unit/scope consistent; only evidence-backed conversions are normalized); a bare ClarifyFields index or a scenario name never authorizes arbitrary values
a contact request with no consignee/supplier business role; a shipping purpose such as 'for delivery updates' does not substitute for the role

the concrete field key is already in this turn's facts (HasSupplierContact, or CargoFacts.ByKey supplier_contact / recipient_contact / recipient_name / supplier_address / delivery_address = provided) - asking again is blocked, and an AskFields authorization never overrides an already-provided field (recipient_name does not prove recipient_contact)
per-clause evaluation so a supplier/consignee mention cannot exempt another contact request
this turn's Decision.AskFields (by field group); a unit modifier such as 'per carton' / 'each pallet' is not a count request by itself

each TimeExpectation (target id, original/canonical place, zone, real UTC offset, local clock/date) derived from the full Decision.TimeTargets and the SAME RuntimeContext must be answered by an OutputTimeClaim bound to that target: an answered clock must match the target's clock AND the stated place/offset; same-clock or same-offset different named places are never merged

every unresolved target must be named inside an explicit place/time-zone clarification question; naming one target does not cover another, and a plain statement that mentions the place ('The shipment is going to Atlantis.') is not a time clarification
Facts.HasWeight/HasDimensions/HasQuoteDestination/HasImages plus the one cargo fact model (ByKey status=provided) for count/weight/dimensions/destination/supplier/recipient
Facts.Destination.QuoteUsable + amazon_warehouse kind

canonical supplier_verification task read back by exact TaskId (EvidenceOrigin=exact-task-readback, ExactTaskMatch, IsOpen) + per-action action records: a future plan needs an open exact task, 'we contacted the supplier' needs a contacted record (legacy contacted/awaiting_supplier_reply status keeps the legacy-status meaning), and 'the supplier confirmed X' needs a structured supplier_reply record whose ConfirmedFields support the stated field/value/unit/scope. A non-empty legacy resolution is legacy-unverified and never authorizes a confirmation

monitor passes PendingListAuthoritative: current pending membership requires processing; duplicate confirmed trigger receipts and historical ledger prevent the same answer being sent again. No five-minute source/time waits, twenty-second new-message floor, two-round wait or cold-start observe-only delay. Not pending never auto-sends. Legacy pause functions remain callable for compatibility but are not monitor reply gates.

entry chain Get-MessageSource -> Get-MessageSourceClass -> Get-MessageSourceClassForLine -> Resolve-MessageSourceClass; the legacy entry and the real consumers (lib/human_style.ps1 Get-HumanMessages, lib/reply_metrics.ps1 Get-SnapshotLineSources) delegate to the same classifier instead of re-deriving a source. Direction comes from the VERIFIED layout structure first (item-right => out, item-left => in, dirsrc=layout); a visible display name and a translation marker are observations only (name-field / translation-marker) and never rewrite an explicit direction. Both structures at once is recorded as dirsrc=conflict and no structure at all as dirsrc=missing: such an event keeps dir=unknown, has no usable identity, and is neither a buyer request nor outbound proof (only legacy lines WITHOUT per-message metadata fall back to the role marker). A real attachment bubble stays a real event even when it has no rich text node. verified human sender field in the per-message @@META payload, or an operator confirmation bound to the exact event; a valid receipt classifies the event as project and never as human. Inline @@SRC text in the body, timestamps, and the absence of a bot marker are NOT human evidence; unknown never counts as human or as our own message
